_comment: Config for export_regions.py. Each region base_jql is the dashboard's authoritative JQL (from the dashboard's 'N filtered issues' navigator), WITH the domain clause removed so the tool can split TDS-AR / TDS-GL, and with the quarter value replaced by the {quarter} placeholder. The tool ANDs the domain selection onto base_jql. NA keys quarter via 'Request Qtr' ~ {quarter}; LAC keys quarter via labels = {quarter}.

NA.label: CIS ALL (North America)
NA.base_jql: issuetype in (Backlog) and not (status = "100-Done" and timespent = 0) and "Request Qtr" ~ {quarter}

LAC.label: LAC (MCA) CIS Conversion
LAC.base_jql: (project = MCAM or "Request Region" = LAC and project not in (WBRCC)) and issuetype = Backlog and (status in ("10-Placeholder", "20-RequirementCompleted", "30-RequirementAccepted", "40-SpecDone", "50-BacklogAccepted", "60-AccurateEstDone", "70-InCoding", "80-InTesting", "90-UATReady", "95-Deployed", "99-OnHold") or status in ("100-Done") and "Deploy Plan ID/Status" !~ None or "Deploy Plan" is not EMPTY) and labels = {quarter}
